name: Lark
description: Lark lets agents search, read, create, and comment on docs, read group chats and messages, and find users in the signed-in Lark workspace. Each user signs in to their own Lark account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find the latest product roadmap doc and summarize it.
Summarize today's messages in the project group chat.
Create a doc with meeting notes from these bullet points.

apps.name: Lark
apps.description: Docs, group chats, and user search, over Lark's MCP server with browser sign-in.
